versions.changelog:
Initial release of the agency-agents skill, providing a full-feature AI agent team framework.

- Delivers 61 specialized AI Agents across 8 departments for professional and collaborative tasks
- Supports single-Agent, multi-Agent orchestrated workflows, and department-level operation
- Includes comprehensive task usage instructions and recommended best practices
- Provides configurable options for workflow tuning and quality assurance
- Includes troubleshooting guidance and support contact information
